title: EdgeRush rate-limiting service config file
description:
A rate-limiting service pod's config file, as `edgerush-ratelimit-service --config`
reads it once, at the start; its certificate files are read again every second.

keys.description: What the pod's keys may hold; left out, each has its value.

mode.description: The rate-limiting mode the pod serves: a pod serves one. Asynchronous when left out.

store.description:
The store's settings, which every pod of a cluster is to share. Either mode runs on
them, and needs them.

tls.description:
The files of the pod's mutual TLS, with data planes and with the other pods alike;
left out, the pod is served plain, to anyone.

ServiceKeys.description: What a service pod's keys may hold.

max_bytes.description:
Bytes the keys may hold, past which the least recently changed are evicted. 256 MiB
when left out.

ServiceMode.description: The rate-limiting mode a service pod serves.

oneOf.description:
Data planes decide from their copies of the keys and share what they admitted every
cycle.
The key's owner decides every request.

ServicePod.description:
A service pod: where it serves, where it is reached, and its data planes' cycle. It takes
a member id of its own each time it starts.

address.description:
Where the other pods and data planes reach it, `host:port`, as it tells them in its
hellos and as it asks to join the store. Needed.

cycle_ms.description:
Milliseconds of the data planes' cycle, in the asynchronous mode alone (the
synchronous mode's store has `store.cycle_ms`). 10 when left out.

listen.description: Where it serves data planes and the other pods, `host:port`.

metrics.description:
Where `/metrics` shows the pod's store and what its mode counts, and `/ready` whether
it is ready; nowhere when left out.

ServicePodTls.description:
The files of a service pod's mutual TLS, each PEM and read again every second, each
relative to the config file's directory unless it is absolute.

authorities.description: The authorities trusted to vouch for every caller.

certificate.description:
The certificate the pod presents to data planes and to the other pods, then the
intermediates.

data_plane_id.description:
The SPIFFE ID of the data plane the pod serves. A caller is told apart by the ID its
certificate carries: the pod's own is the pods', this one the data plane's, and any
other is refused.

ServiceStore.description:
The store's settings: the pods a new one asks first, and how every pod of the cluster
watches the others and shapes it. The service checks the timings against each other.

cycle_ms.description:
Milliseconds between an owner's copies of what changed to its replicas. 10 when left
out.

election_jitter_ms.description:
The most milliseconds a pod waits, beyond `silence_ms`, before it stands for leader:
each waits a part of it of its own, so that two rarely stand together. 200 when left
out.

forwarder_decides.description:
Whether a pod a data plane asks about a key whose owner it has not heard for
`stop_serving_ms` decides the key itself, from its copy, rather than forward the ask to
an owner it cannot reach: so that an owner gone has its keys held to their limits while
a replica takes over, the charges lost if another replica takes them. A replica only,
holding its own lease. True when left out.

heartbeat_ms.description: Milliseconds between a pod's heartbeats to every other. 100 when left out.

replicas.description:
Replicas each shard keeps beside its owner, as far as there are pods for them. 2 when
left out.

seeds.description:
Pods' addresses, `host:port`, which a pod starting asks who answers there until it is
a member. None when left out.

shards.description:
The number of shards keys are split into, fixed for the cluster's life: a pod of
another number does not join. 256 when left out.

silence_ms.description:
Milliseconds a pod goes unheard before the leader takes it out, or a voting pod takes
its leader for gone. 600 when left out.

skew_warning_ms.description:
Milliseconds a peer's wall clock may be off from a pod's before the pod warns of it.
250 when left out.

stop_serving_ms.description:
Milliseconds a pod goes without hearing a majority of the voting pods before it stops
serving: more than a heartbeat, and two heartbeats less than `silence_ms` at least, so
that a pod cut off stops before the others take its shards. 400 when left out.
